# jamfplatform_ai_governance_policy (List Resource)

Lists Jamf AI Governance policies, for `terraform query` and for importing existing policies in bulk. Archived policies are never returned.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Create the API integration with **Platform environment** scope, then grant it the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Compliance | AI policies | Read | `ai-policies` |



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `schema_drift_only` (Boolean) When true, return only policies whose settings schema version is behind the one the platform now offers for their tool. These are the policies worth reviewing after a tool publishes a new schema.
